findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name XXE in Excel file reader
 * @description XML parsing in reader module without XXE protection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/xxe-excel-reader
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("etree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XMLParser", "iterparse"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XMLParser", "iterparse"]).getACall()
  ) and
  // Focus on reader module
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("openpyxl/reader/%")
select call, "Potentially unsafe XML parsing in Excel file reader that may be vulnerable to XXE attacks."
findings.hypothesis: XXE vulnerability in Excel file reader module where untrusted files are parsed
